Senses.Explanation: Langye Huijue gives the servant-master reversal as his verdict on Zhaozhou probing Zhuyu's water and then walking away. The same record later puts the pair directly into Langye's answer after the source-unnamed questioner tries to cap his saying; Langye follows it with thirty blows. Dongchan Xiu uses it to answer why a supposedly benevolent spirit is struck by lightning. Across the turns, the saying names a reversal in which what should serve takes command and what should protect becomes exposed.
